name: loongs/oauth
description: loong-swoole OAuth 2.1 authorization server + resource server — authorization_code with PKCE (S256), client_credentials, rotating refresh tokens, RFC 7009 revocation, RFC 7662 introspection, RFC 8414 metadata, RFC 9207 iss, encrypted RFC 9068 access tokens (nested JWS-in-JWE, RFC 7516); storage-agnostic core with loongs/orm (tenant-aware), loongs/cache and memory stores

suggest.loongs/orm: OrmStorage: MySQL storage, one set of OAuth tables per tenant (Orm::tenant / explicit connection spec); OrmStorage::installOn() / ./loongs oauth:install create them
suggest.loongs/cache: CacheTokenStorage: authorization codes and tokens in Redis (or any loongs/cache store)
suggest.loongs/framework: BearerMiddleware (resource server), OAuthRoutes (authorization server endpoints), oauth:install console command
suggest.ext-sodium: Not required; random_bytes() (CSPRNG) is used for every secret
